title: The Brain-Changing Benefits of Exercise | Wendy Suzuki | TED
speaker: TED
zh: 【TED】運動改變大腦的好處|溫蒂鈴木 |泰德（精選雙語跟讀教材）

cues.text: What if I told you there was something that you can do right now
cues.en: What if I told you there was something that you can do right now
cues.zh: 如果我告訴各位， 有件你們現在就可以做的事，

cues.text: that would have an immediate, positive benefit for your brain
cues.en: that would have an immediate, positive benefit for your brain
cues.zh: 對你的大腦會立即產生正面的好處，

cues.text: including your mood and your focus?
cues.en: including your mood and your focus?
cues.zh: 包括你的心情和專注都會受惠， 你會如何呢？

cues.text: And what if I told you that same thing could actually last a long time
cues.en: And what if I told you that same thing could actually last a long time
cues.zh: 如果我告訴各位， 這事能持續很久的時間，

cues.text: and protect your brain from different conditions like depression, Alzheimer's disease or dementia.
cues.en: and protect your brain from different conditions like depression, Alzheimer's disease or dementia.
cues.zh: 並保護你的大腦免於不同的病症， 比如憂鬱、阿茲海默症， 或失智症的侵擾，你會如何？

cues.text: Would you do it?
cues.en: Would you do it?
cues.zh: 你們願意做這件事嗎？

cues.text: Yes!
cues.en: Yes!
cues.zh: 願意！

cues.text: I am talking about the powerful effects of physical activity.
cues.en: I am talking about the powerful effects of physical activity.
cues.zh: 我談的是活動身體的強大效應。

cues.text: Simply moving your body, has immediate, long-lasting and protective benefits for your brain.
cues.en: Simply moving your body, has immediate, long-lasting and protective benefits for your brain.
cues.zh: 只要很單純地去動你的身體， 就能對你的大腦產生立即、 持久，且有保護作用的益處，

cues.text: And that can last for the rest of your life.
cues.en: And that can last for the rest of your life.
cues.zh: 且持續一生。

cues.text: So what I want to do today is tell you a story about how I used my deep understanding of neuroscience,
cues.en: So what I want to do today is tell you a story about how I used my deep understanding of neuroscience,
cues.zh: 所以，今天我要跟各位說個故事， 這故事有關身為神經科學教授的我，

cues.text: as a professor of neuroscience, to essentially do an experiment on myself
cues.en: as a professor of neuroscience, to essentially do an experiment on myself
cues.zh: 如何用我對於神經科學的深入瞭解， 在我自己身上實驗，

cues.text: in which I discovered the science underlying why exercise is the most transformative thing
cues.en: in which I discovered the science underlying why exercise is the most transformative thing
cues.zh: 從實驗中找到科學理由來說明， 為什麼在現今你能做的 所有事情當中，

cues.text: that you can do for your brain today.
cues.en: that you can do for your brain today.
cues.zh: 運動最能改變你的大腦。

cues.text: Now, as a neuroscientist, I know that our brains,
cues.en: Now, as a neuroscientist, I know that our brains,
cues.zh: 身為神經科學家， 我知道我們的大腦，

cues.text: that is the thing in our head right now, that is the most complex structure known to humankind.
cues.en: that is the thing in our head right now, that is the most complex structure known to humankind.
cues.zh: 也就是在我們頭裡面的那個東西， 是人類所知最複雜的結構。

cues.text: But it's one thing to talk about the brain, and it's another to see it.
cues.en: But it's one thing to talk about the brain, and it's another to see it.
cues.zh: 但，談論大腦是一回事， 看大腦又是另一回事了。

cues.text: So here is a real preserved human brain.
cues.en: So here is a real preserved human brain.
cues.zh: 這是一個真正儲存起來的人類大腦。

cues.text: And it's going to illustrate two key areas that we are going to talk about today.
cues.en: And it's going to illustrate two key areas that we are going to talk about today.
cues.zh: 它將會說明我們今天 要談到的兩個關鍵區域。

cues.text: The first is the prefrontal cortex, right behind your forehead,
cues.en: The first is the prefrontal cortex, right behind your forehead,
cues.zh: 第一個是「前額葉皮質」， 就在你的額頭後面，

cues.text: critical for things like decision-making, focus, attention and your personality.
cues.en: critical for things like decision-making, focus, attention and your personality.
cues.zh: 對決策、專注、注意力， 以及你的人格來說很重要。

cues.text: The second key area is located in the temporal lobe, shown right here.
cues.en: The second key area is located in the temporal lobe, shown right here.
cues.zh: 第二個關鍵區域位在「顳葉」， 就在圖上的這裡。

cues.text: You have two temporal lobes in your brain, the right and the left, and deep in the temporal lobe is a key structure
cues.en: You have two temporal lobes in your brain, the right and the left, and deep in the temporal lobe is a key structure
cues.zh: 你的大腦中有兩個顳葉，一右一左， 顳葉的深處是個關鍵的結構，

cues.text: critical for your ability to form and retain new long-term memories for facts and events.
cues.en: critical for your ability to form and retain new long-term memories for facts and events.
cues.zh: 重要功能是讓你能夠 針對事實和事件來形成 並維持新的長期記憶。

cues.text: And that structure is called the hippocampus.
cues.en: And that structure is called the hippocampus.
cues.zh: 那個結構就叫做「海馬迴」。

cues.text: So I've always been fascinated with the hippocampus.
cues.en: So I've always been fascinated with the hippocampus.
cues.zh: 我一直很迷海馬迴。

cues.text: How could it be that an event that lasts just a moment,
cues.en: How could it be that an event that lasts just a moment,
cues.zh: 怎麼有可能，一個短暫的事件，

cues.text: say, your first kiss, or the moment your first child was born,
cues.en: say, your first kiss, or the moment your first child was born,
cues.zh: 比如，你的初吻， 或是你的第一個孩子出生的那一刻，

cues.text: can form a memory that has changed your brain, that lasts an entire lifetime?
cues.en: can form a memory that has changed your brain, that lasts an entire lifetime?
cues.zh: 能夠形成一個記憶， 這記憶能改變你的大腦， 且一生都不會忘記？

cues.text: That's what I want to understand.
cues.en: That's what I want to understand.
cues.zh: 那是我想要了解的。

cues.text: I wanted to start and record the activity of individual brain cells
cues.en: I wanted to start and record the activity of individual brain cells
cues.zh: 我想要記下受試者在形成記憶時，

cues.text: in the hippocampus as subjects were forming new memories.
cues.en: in the hippocampus as subjects were forming new memories.
cues.zh: 海馬迴中的 每個腦細胞的活動。

cues.text: And essentially try and decode how those brief bursts of electrical activity,
cues.en: And essentially try and decode how those brief bursts of electrical activity,
cues.zh: 並真的試圖破解那些 短暫的突升電流活動，

cues.text: which is how neurons communicate with each other, how those brief bursts either allowed us to form a new memory, or did not.
cues.en: which is how neurons communicate with each other, how those brief bursts either allowed us to form a new memory, or did not.
cues.zh: 也就是神經元彼此溝通的方式， 那些短暫的突升怎麼讓我們 形成新記憶，或沒形成記憶？

cues.text: But a few years ago, I did something very unusual in science.
cues.en: But a few years ago, I did something very unusual in science.
cues.zh: 但幾年前，我做了一件 在科學中被認為很不尋常的事。

cues.text: As a full professor of neural science, I decided to completely switch my research program.
cues.en: As a full professor of neural science, I decided to completely switch my research program.
cues.zh: 身為神經科學的正教授， 我決定完全轉換我的研究計畫。

cues.text: Because I encountered something that was so amazing,
cues.en: Because I encountered something that was so amazing,
cues.zh: 因為我遇到了非常驚人的事，

cues.text: with the potential to change so many lives that I had to study it.
cues.en: with the potential to change so many lives that I had to study it.
cues.zh: 它有潛能可以改變許多人的生命， 我得要去研究它。

cues.text: I discovered and I experienced the brain-changing effects of exercise.
cues.en: I discovered and I experienced the brain-changing effects of exercise.
cues.zh: 我發現且體驗到 運動有改變大腦的效應。

cues.text: And I did it in a completely inadvertent way.
cues.en: And I did it in a completely inadvertent way.
cues.zh: 我完全是在無意間發現的。

cues.text: I was actually at the height of all the memory work that I was doing --
cues.en: I was actually at the height of all the memory work that I was doing --
cues.zh: 其實當時我正處於所進行的 記憶研究工作的頂峰，

cues.text: data was pouring in, I was becoming known in my field for all of this memory work.
cues.en: data was pouring in, I was becoming known in my field for all of this memory work.
cues.zh: 資料不斷地湧入， 在我的領域中，我開始因為 這項記憶研究而變得出名。

cues.text: And it should have been going great. It was, scientifically.
cues.en: And it should have been going great. It was, scientifically.
cues.zh: 本來應該很順利。 在科學上的確很順利。

cues.text: But when I stuck my head out of my lab door,
cues.en: But when I stuck my head out of my lab door,
cues.zh: 但當我從實驗室門探出頭，

cues.text: I noticed something.
cues.en: I noticed something.
cues.zh: 我注意到了某件事。

cues.text: I had no social life.
cues.en: I had no social life.
cues.zh: 我沒有社交生活。

cues.text: I spent too much time listening to those brain cells in a dark room, by myself.
cues.en: I spent too much time listening to those brain cells in a dark room, by myself.
cues.zh: 我花了太多時間， 獨自在黑暗的房間中 傾聽那些腦細胞。

cues.text: I didn't move my body at all.
cues.en: I didn't move my body at all.
cues.zh: 我完全沒動我的身體。

cues.text: I had gained 25 pounds.
cues.en: I had gained 25 pounds.
cues.zh: 我的體重增加了二十五磅。

cues.text: And actually, it took me many years to realize it, I was actually miserable.
cues.en: And actually, it took me many years to realize it, I was actually miserable.
cues.zh: 而且，我花了很多年，才瞭解到 我其實很悲慘。

cues.text: And I shouldn't be miserable.
cues.en: And I shouldn't be miserable.
cues.zh: 而我不應該如此悲慘。

cues.text: And I went on a river-rafting trip -- by myself, because I had no social life.
cues.en: And I went on a river-rafting trip -- by myself, because I had no social life.
cues.zh: 我參加一趟泛舟之旅── 自己一個人，因為我沒有社交生活。

cues.text: And I came back -- thinking, "Oh, my God, I was the weakest person on that trip."
cues.en: And I came back -- thinking, "Oh, my God, I was the weakest person on that trip."
cues.zh: 接著我回來了。 （笑聲） 心想：「我的天， 我是那趟旅行中最弱的人。」

cues.text: And I came back with a mission.
cues.en: And I came back with a mission.
cues.zh: 回來後我就有了一個使命。

cues.text: I said, "I'm never going to feel like the weakest person on a river-rafting trip again."
cues.en: I said, "I'm never going to feel like the weakest person on a river-rafting trip again."
cues.zh: 我說：「我再也不要覺得自己是 泛舟之旅中最弱的人了。」

cues.text: And that's what made me go to the gym.
cues.en: And that's what made me go to the gym.
cues.zh: 這就是我上健身房的動力來源。

cues.text: And I focused my type-A personality on going to all the exercise classes at the gym.
cues.en: And I focused my type-A personality on going to all the exercise classes at the gym.
cues.zh: 我把我的Ａ型人格專注在 去參加健身房中所有的運動課程。

cues.text: I tried everything.
cues.en: I tried everything.
cues.zh: 我什麼都嘗試了，

cues.text: I went to kickbox, dance, yoga, step class,
cues.en: I went to kickbox, dance, yoga, step class,
cues.zh: 我去試了自由搏擊、 跳舞、瑜伽、階梯課程，

cues.text: and at first it was really hard.
cues.en: and at first it was really hard.
cues.zh: 一開始真的很辛苦。

cues.text: But what I noticed is that after every sweat-inducing workout that I tried,
cues.en: But what I noticed is that after every sweat-inducing workout that I tried,
cues.zh: 但我注意到，在我每回嘗試 會讓我滿身大汗的運動之後，

cues.text: I had this great mood boost and this great energy boost.
cues.en: I had this great mood boost and this great energy boost.
cues.zh: 我的情緒和能量都會大大提升。

cues.text: And that's what kept me going back to the gym.
cues.en: And that's what kept me going back to the gym.
cues.zh: 這就是為什麼我會 一直持續回到健身房。

cues.text: Well, I started feeling stronger.
cues.en: Well, I started feeling stronger.
cues.zh: 我開始感覺比較強壯了。

cues.text: I started feeling better, I even lost that 25 pounds.
cues.en: I started feeling better, I even lost that 25 pounds.
cues.zh: 我開始感覺更好了， 我甚至把那二十五磅給減掉了。

cues.text: And now, fast-forward a year and a half into this regular exercise program
cues.en: And now, fast-forward a year and a half into this regular exercise program
cues.zh: 現在，從我開始做日常鍛鍊 至今已有一年半多了，

cues.text: and I noticed something that really made me sit up and take notice.
cues.en: and I noticed something that really made me sit up and take notice.
cues.zh: 我注意到一件事，它讓我 吃驚並吸引了我的注意。

cues.text: I was sitting at my desk, writing a research grant, and a thought went through my mind
cues.en: I was sitting at my desk, writing a research grant, and a thought went through my mind
cues.zh: 我坐在桌前寫研究補助申請書， 腦中浮現一個想法，

cues.text: that had never gone through my mind before.
cues.en: that had never gone through my mind before.
cues.zh: 那是我以前從來沒有想過的。

cues.text: And that thought was, "Gee, grant-writing is going well today."
cues.en: And that thought was, "Gee, grant-writing is going well today."
cues.zh: 那個想法就是： 「天，今天的研究補助 申請寫得真順利。」

cues.text: And all the scientists -- yeah, all the scientists always laugh when I say that,
cues.en: And all the scientists -- yeah, all the scientists always laugh when I say that,
cues.zh: 所有的科學家── （笑聲） 是啊，當我那麼說時， 科學家都會笑出來，

cues.text: because grant-writing never goes well.
cues.en: because grant-writing never goes well.
cues.zh: 因為寫補助申請從來就不會順利。

cues.text: It is so hard; you're always pulling your hair out, trying to come up with that million-dollar-winning idea.
cues.en: It is so hard; you're always pulling your hair out, trying to come up with that million-dollar-winning idea.
cues.zh: 它真的很難搞，你總是要想破頭， 試圖提個能贏得百萬美元的想法。

cues.text: But I realized that the grant-writing was going well, because I was able to focus and maintain my attention
cues.en: But I realized that the grant-writing was going well, because I was able to focus and maintain my attention
cues.zh: 但我發現，補助申請能寫得很順利， 是因為我專注和維持注意力的時間，

cues.text: for longer than I had before.
cues.en: for longer than I had before.
cues.zh: 都比以前更長。

cues.text: And my long-term memory -- what I was studying in my own lab --
cues.en: And my long-term memory -- what I was studying in my own lab --
cues.zh: 且我的長期記憶── 我的實驗室的研究主題──

cues.text: seemed to be better in me.
cues.en: seemed to be better in me.
cues.zh: 似乎在我身上也變得更好。

cues.text: And that's when I put it together.
cues.en: And that's when I put it together.
cues.zh: 就在那時，我把一切都連起來了。

cues.text: Maybe all that exercise that I had included and added to my life
cues.en: Maybe all that exercise that I had included and added to my life
cues.zh: 也許，我加在生活中的那些運動

cues.text: was changing my brain.
cues.en: was changing my brain.
cues.zh: 在改變我的大腦。

cues.text: Maybe I did an experiment on myself without even knowing it.
cues.en: Maybe I did an experiment on myself without even knowing it.
cues.zh: 也許我在自己身上 做了實驗而不自知。

cues.text: So as a curious neuroscientist, I went to the literature to see what I could find about what we knew
cues.en: So as a curious neuroscientist, I went to the literature to see what I could find about what we knew
cues.zh: 身為好奇的神經科學家， 我去查研究文獻， 看看有沒有什麼已知資訊 與運動對大腦的效應有關。

cues.text: about the effects of exercise on the brain.
cues.en: about the effects of exercise on the brain.
cues.zh: 與運動對大腦的效應有關。

cues.text: And what I found was an exciting and a growing literature
cues.en: And what I found was an exciting and a growing literature
cues.zh: 我發現的文獻很讓人興奮， 且還在不斷增加中，

cues.text: that was essentially showing everything that I noticed in myself.
cues.en: that was essentially showing everything that I noticed in myself.
cues.zh: 基本上，文獻完全點出了 我在身上注意到的所有改變。

cues.text: Better mood, better energy, better memory, better attention.
cues.en: Better mood, better energy, better memory, better attention.
cues.zh: 更好的心情、更高的能量、 更好的記憶、更佳的注意力。

cues.text: And the more I learned, the more I realized how powerful exercise was.
cues.en: And the more I learned, the more I realized how powerful exercise was.
cues.zh: 我學得越多， 我就越能瞭解運動有多強大。

cues.text: Which eventually led me to the big decision to completely shift my research focus.
cues.en: Which eventually led me to the big decision to completely shift my research focus.
cues.zh: 最終，這導致了我做出重大決定， 完全轉變我的研究重心。

cues.text: And so now, after several years of really focusing on this question,
cues.en: And so now, after several years of really focusing on this question,
cues.zh: 所以，在真正投入這個問題幾年後，

cues.text: I've come to the following conclusion: that exercise is the most transformative thing
cues.en: I've come to the following conclusion: that exercise is the most transformative thing
cues.zh: 我得到了下列的結論： 在現今你能做的所有事情當中，

cues.text: that you can do for your brain today for the following three reasons.
cues.en: that you can do for your brain today for the following three reasons.
cues.zh: 運動最能改變你的大腦， 理由是以下三個。

cues.text: Number one: it has immediate effects on your brain.
cues.en: Number one: it has immediate effects on your brain.
cues.zh: 第一：運動對你的大腦 有立即的效應。

cues.text: A single workout that you do will immediately increase levels of neurotransmitters
cues.en: A single workout that you do will immediately increase levels of neurotransmitters
cues.zh: 你做的每一次運動， 都會立即增加神經傳遞質的量，

cues.text: like dopamine, serotonin and noradrenaline.
cues.en: like dopamine, serotonin and noradrenaline.
cues.zh: 如多巴胺、血清素、正腎上腺素。

cues.text: That is going to increase your mood right after that workout, exactly what I was feeling.
cues.en: That is going to increase your mood right after that workout, exactly what I was feeling.
cues.zh: 這會在你運動之後 馬上提升你的心情， 那正是我的感受。

cues.text: My lab showed that a single workout can improve your ability to shift and focus attention,
cues.en: My lab showed that a single workout can improve your ability to shift and focus attention,
cues.zh: 我的實驗室顯示，單一次運動 就能改善你轉移和聚焦的能力，

cues.text: and that focus improvement will last for at least two hours.
cues.en: and that focus improvement will last for at least two hours.
cues.zh: 而那專注的改善 會持續至少兩個小時。

cues.text: And finally, studies have shown that a single workout will improve your reaction times
cues.en: And finally, studies have shown that a single workout will improve your reaction times
cues.zh: 最後，研究顯示， 單一次運動就會改善你的反應時間，

cues.text: which basically means that you are going to be faster at catching that cup of Starbucks
cues.en: which basically means that you are going to be faster at catching that cup of Starbucks
cues.zh: 基本上，那就表示 如果一杯星巴克咖啡從櫃臺滑落，

cues.text: that falls off the counter, which is very, very important.
cues.en: that falls off the counter, which is very, very important.
cues.zh: 你能更快速接住它， 這點是非常非常重要的。

cues.text: But these immediate effects are transient, they help you right after.
cues.en: But these immediate effects are transient, they help you right after.
cues.zh: 但這些立即的效應很短暫， 在運動剛結束時幫助你。

cues.text: What you have to do is do what I did, that is change your exercise regime, increase your cardiorespiratory function,
cues.en: What you have to do is do what I did, that is change your exercise regime, increase your cardiorespiratory function,
cues.zh: 你們得要做我所做的， 也就是改變你的運動規律， 增加你的心肺功能，

cues.text: to get the long-lasting effects.
cues.en: to get the long-lasting effects.
cues.zh: 才能得到持久的效應。

cues.text: And these effects are long-lasting because exercise actually changes the brain's anatomy,
cues.en: And these effects are long-lasting because exercise actually changes the brain's anatomy,
cues.zh: 這些效應之所以能持久， 是因為運動確實能改變大腦的結構、

cues.text: physiology and function.
cues.en: physiology and function.
cues.zh: 生理機能，以及功能。

cues.text: Let's start with my favorite brain area, the hippocampus.
cues.en: Let's start with my favorite brain area, the hippocampus.
cues.zh: 我們從我最愛的 大腦區域海馬迴開始。

cues.text: The hippocampus -- or exercise actually produces brand new brain cells,
cues.en: The hippocampus -- or exercise actually produces brand new brain cells,
cues.zh: 海馬迴── 運動確實能製造出全新的腦細胞，

cues.text: new brain cells in the hippocampus, that actually increase its volume,
cues.en: new brain cells in the hippocampus, that actually increase its volume,
cues.zh: 海馬迴中新的腦細胞能增加容積，

cues.text: as well as improve your long-term memory, OK?
cues.en: as well as improve your long-term memory, OK?
cues.zh: 還能改善你的長期記憶。

cues.text: And that including in you and me.
cues.en: And that including in you and me.
cues.zh: 對你我皆是如此。

cues.text: Number two: the most common finding in neuroscience studies,
cues.en: Number two: the most common finding in neuroscience studies,
cues.zh: 第二：在神經科學研究中 最常見的研究發現，

cues.text: looking at effects of long-term exercise, is improved attention function dependent on your prefrontal cortex.
cues.en: looking at effects of long-term exercise, is improved attention function dependent on your prefrontal cortex.
cues.zh: 在長期運動的效應這方面， 就是改善注意力功能， 而這功能取決於你的前額葉皮質。

cues.text: You not only get better focus and attention, but the volume of the hippocampus increases as well.
cues.en: You not only get better focus and attention, but the volume of the hippocampus increases as well.
cues.zh: 你不但會有更佳的專注和注意力， 海馬迴的容量也會增加。

cues.text: And finally, you not only get immediate effects of mood with exercise
cues.en: And finally, you not only get immediate effects of mood with exercise
cues.zh: 最後，你做運動會得到的 不只是心情上的立即效應，

cues.text: but those last for a long time.
cues.en: but those last for a long time.
cues.zh: 還會有長期的效應。

cues.text: So you get long-lasting increases in those good mood neurotransmitters.
cues.en: So you get long-lasting increases in those good mood neurotransmitters.
cues.zh: 所以，你的好心情神經 傳遞質就能得持續增加。

cues.text: But really, the most transformative thing that exercise will do
cues.en: But really, the most transformative thing that exercise will do
cues.zh: 但其實，運動能帶來最大的轉變，

cues.text: is its protective effects on your brain.
cues.en: is its protective effects on your brain.
cues.zh: 就是對大腦產生保護效應。

cues.text: Here you can think about the brain like a muscle.
cues.en: Here you can think about the brain like a muscle.
cues.zh: 可以把大腦想成是肌肉。

cues.text: The more you're working out, the bigger and stronger your hippocampus and prefrontal cortex gets.
cues.en: The more you're working out, the bigger and stronger your hippocampus and prefrontal cortex gets.
cues.zh: 你運動得越多， 你的海馬迴和前額葉皮質 就會更大、更強壯。

cues.text: Why is that important?
cues.en: Why is that important?
cues.zh: 為什麼那很重要？

cues.text: Because the prefrontal cortex and the hippocampus are the two areas that are most susceptible to neurodegenerative diseases
cues.en: Because the prefrontal cortex and the hippocampus are the two areas that are most susceptible to neurodegenerative diseases
cues.zh: 因為前額葉皮質和海馬迴 這兩個區域最容易因 神經退化性疾病和老化

cues.text: and normal cognitive decline in aging.
cues.en: and normal cognitive decline in aging.
cues.zh: 而使得正常認知退化。

cues.text: So with increased exercise over your lifetime, you're not going to cure dementia or Alzheimer's disease,
cues.en: So with increased exercise over your lifetime, you're not going to cure dementia or Alzheimer's disease,
cues.zh: 在你的一生中增加運動 並不能治癒失智症或阿茲海默症，

cues.text: but what you're going to do is you're going to create the strongest, biggest hippocampus and prefrontal cortex
cues.en: but what you're going to do is you're going to create the strongest, biggest hippocampus and prefrontal cortex
cues.zh: 但能創造出 最強壯、最大的海馬迴 和前額葉皮質，

cues.text: so it takes longer for these diseases to actually have an effect.
cues.en: so it takes longer for these diseases to actually have an effect.
cues.zh: 所以這些疾病要更長的時間 才會對你產生實際的影響。

cues.text: You can think of exercise, therefore, as a supercharged 401K for your brain, OK?
cues.en: You can think of exercise, therefore, as a supercharged 401K for your brain, OK?
cues.zh: 因此，你可以把運動想成是 大腦的加強版 401K 退休福利計畫。

cues.text: And it's even better, because it's free.
cues.en: And it's even better, because it's free.
cues.zh: 它還更好，因為它是免費的。

cues.text: So this is the point in the talk where everybody says, "That sounds so interesting, Wendy,
cues.en: So this is the point in the talk where everybody says, "That sounds so interesting, Wendy,
cues.zh: 演說到這個時點，大家通常會說： 「溫蒂，那聽起來好有趣，

cues.text: but I really will only want to know one thing.
cues.en: but I really will only want to know one thing.
cues.zh: 但我其實只想知道一件事，

cues.text: And that is, just tell me the minimum amount of exercise
cues.en: And that is, just tell me the minimum amount of exercise
cues.zh: 那就是隻要告訴我 最少要做多少運動

cues.text: I need to get all these changes." And so I'm going to tell you the answer to that question.
cues.en: I need to get all these changes." And so I'm going to tell you the answer to that question.
cues.zh: 才能得到所有這些改變。」 （笑聲） 所以，我會告訴各位 這個問題的答案。

cues.text: First, good news: you don't have to become a triathlete to get these effects.
cues.en: First, good news: you don't have to become a triathlete to get these effects.
cues.zh: 首先，好訊息：你不用變成鐵人三項 運動員也可以得到這些效應。

cues.text: The rule of thumb is you want to get three to four times a week exercise
cues.en: The rule of thumb is you want to get three to four times a week exercise
cues.zh: 經驗法則是，每週要運動三到四次，

cues.text: minimum 30 minutes an exercise session, and you want to get aerobic exercise in.
cues.en: minimum 30 minutes an exercise session, and you want to get aerobic exercise in.
cues.zh: 每次運動至少要有三十分鐘， 且你需要做一些有氧運動。

cues.text: That is, get your heart rate up.
cues.en: That is, get your heart rate up.
cues.zh: 也就是要讓你的心跳升高。

cues.text: And the good news is, you don't have to go to the gym to get a very expensive gym membership.
cues.en: And the good news is, you don't have to go to the gym to get a very expensive gym membership.
cues.zh: 好訊息是你不需要去健身房 付很貴的健身房會費。

cues.text: Add an extra walk around the block in your power walk.
cues.en: Add an extra walk around the block in your power walk.
cues.zh: 在你健走的時候， 再額外多走一個街區。

cues.text: You see stairs -- take stairs.
cues.en: You see stairs -- take stairs.
cues.zh: 如果你看見有樓梯可走，走樓梯。

cues.text: And power-vacuuming can be as good as the aerobics class
cues.en: And power-vacuuming can be as good as the aerobics class
cues.zh: power-vacuuming 是很好的有氧課程選擇，

cues.text: that you were going to take at the gym.
cues.en: that you were going to take at the gym.
cues.zh: 如果你到健身房運動的話。

cues.text: So I've gone from memory pioneer to exercise explorer.
cues.en: So I've gone from memory pioneer to exercise explorer.
cues.zh: 所以，我從記憶的先驅拓荒者， 變成了運動探索者。

cues.text: From going into the innermost workings of the brain,
cues.en: From going into the innermost workings of the brain,
cues.zh: 從進入大腦最深處的運作活動，

cues.text: to trying to understand how exercise can improve our brain function,
cues.en: to trying to understand how exercise can improve our brain function,
cues.zh: 變成試圖瞭解運動 如何能改善大腦功能，

cues.text: and my goal in my lab right now is to go beyond that rule of thumb that I just gave you --
cues.en: and my goal in my lab right now is to go beyond that rule of thumb that I just gave you --
cues.zh: 現在，我的實驗室的目標 是要超越我剛剛 跟各位說的經驗法則──

cues.text: three to four times a week, 30 minutes.
cues.en: three to four times a week, 30 minutes.
cues.zh: 每週三到四次，每次三十分鐘。

cues.text: I want to understand the optimum exercise prescription
cues.en: I want to understand the optimum exercise prescription
cues.zh: 我想要了解最理想的 運動處方是什麼，

cues.text: for you, at your age, at your fitness level,
cues.en: for you, at your age, at your fitness level,
cues.zh: 針對你，根據你的年齡、 你的健康程度、

cues.text: for your genetic background, to maximize the effects of exercise today
cues.en: for your genetic background, to maximize the effects of exercise today
cues.zh: 你的基因背景， 來把今天的運動效應給最大化，

cues.text: and also to improve your brain and protect your brain the best
cues.en: and also to improve your brain and protect your brain the best
cues.zh: 同時把改善及保護 你的大腦做到最好，

cues.text: for the rest of your life.
cues.en: for the rest of your life.
cues.zh: 讓你一生都能受益。

cues.text: But it's one thing to talk about exercise, and it's another to do it.
cues.en: But it's one thing to talk about exercise, and it's another to do it.
cues.zh: 但，「談」運動是一回事， 「做」運動是另一回事。

cues.text: So I'm going to invoke my power as a certified exercise instructor,
cues.en: So I'm going to invoke my power as a certified exercise instructor,
cues.zh: 所以，我要實行我身為 認證運動指導員的權力，

cues.text: to ask you all to stand up.
cues.en: to ask you all to stand up.
cues.zh: 請各位都站起來。

cues.text: We're going to do just one minute of exercise.
cues.en: We're going to do just one minute of exercise.
cues.zh: 我們只運動一分鐘。

cues.text: It's call-and-response, just do what I do, say what I say, and make sure you don't punch your neighbor, OK?
cues.en: It's call-and-response, just do what I do, say what I say, and make sure you don't punch your neighbor, OK?
cues.zh: 它類似「呼喊和回應」， 只要做我做的動作，說我說的話， 然後小心不要打到旁邊的人，好嗎？

cues.text: Music!
cues.en: Music!
cues.zh: 音樂！

cues.text: Five, six, seven, eight, it's right, left, right, left.
cues.en: Five, six, seven, eight, it's right, left, right, left.
cues.zh: 五、六、七、八，右、左、右、左。

cues.text: And I say, I am strong now.
cues.en: And I say, I am strong now.
cues.zh: 我說，我現在很強壯。

cues.text: Let's hear you.
cues.en: Let's hear you.
cues.zh: 換你們說。

cues.text: Audience: I am strong now.
cues.en: Audience: I am strong now.
cues.zh: 觀眾：我現在很強壯。

cues.text: Wendy Suzuki: Ladies, I am Wonder Woman-strong.
cues.en: Wendy Suzuki: Ladies, I am Wonder Woman-strong.
cues.zh: 溫蒂鈴木：女士們， 我是神力女超人── 強壯。

cues.text: Let's hear you!
cues.en: Let's hear you!
cues.zh: 換你們說！

cues.text: Audience: I am Wonder Woman-strong.
cues.en: Audience: I am Wonder Woman-strong.
cues.zh: 觀眾：我是神力女超人── 強壯。

cues.text: WS: New move -- uppercut, right and left.
cues.en: WS: New move -- uppercut, right and left.
cues.zh: 溫蒂：新動作── 上勾拳，右、左。

cues.text: I am inspired now. You say it!
cues.en: I am inspired now. You say it!
cues.zh: 我現在受到鼓舞。換你們說！

cues.text: Audience: I am inspired now.
cues.en: Audience: I am inspired now.
cues.zh: 觀眾：我現在受到鼓舞。

cues.text: WS: Last move -- pull it down, right and left, right and left.
cues.en: WS: Last move -- pull it down, right and left, right and left.
cues.zh: 溫蒂：最後一個動作── 拉下來，右、左、右、左。

cues.text: I say, I am on fire now! You say it.
cues.en: I say, I am on fire now! You say it.
cues.zh: 我說，我現在如火燃燒！換你們說。

cues.text: Audience: I am on fire now.
cues.en: Audience: I am on fire now.
cues.zh: 觀眾：我現在如火燃燒。

cues.text: WS: And done! OK, good job!
cues.en: WS: And done! OK, good job!
cues.zh: 溫蒂：完成！好，做得好！

cues.text: Thank you.
cues.en: Thank you.
cues.zh: 謝謝。

cues.text: I want to leave you with one last thought.
cues.en: I want to leave you with one last thought.
cues.zh: 最後我想留給各位一個想法，

cues.text: And that is, bringing exercise in your life will not only give you a happier, more protective life today,
cues.en: And that is, bringing exercise in your life will not only give you a happier, more protective life today,
cues.zh: 就是把運動帶入你的生活 不僅讓你今天更快樂、更受保護，

cues.text: but it will protect your brain from incurable diseases.
cues.en: but it will protect your brain from incurable diseases.
cues.zh: 還能保護你的大腦， 不受無法治癒的疾病所侵害。

cues.text: And in this way it will change the trajectory of your life
cues.en: And in this way it will change the trajectory of your life
cues.zh: 這麼一來就能改變你人生的軌道，

cues.text: for the better.
cues.en: for the better.
cues.zh: 朝著更好的方向。

cues.text: Thank you very much.
cues.en: Thank you very much.
cues.zh: 非常謝謝。

cues.text: Thank you.
cues.en: Thank you.
cues.zh: 謝謝。
